40007289.author: पदार्थः
40007289.content: सः that, महाबाहुः  mightyarmed, दूषणः Dusana, हन्यमानम्  getting killed, स्वकम् his own, सैन्यम् army, निरीक्ष्य  seeing, भीमवेगान्  dreadfuly quick, दुरासदान्  dangerous to face, समरेषु in war, अनिवर्तिनः who will not beat a retreat, पञ्च सहस्रान् five thousand, राक्षसान् demons, सन्दिदेश led.

40007289.author: Translation
40007289.content: Mightyarmed Dusana saw  the army  getting killed in war. He led the forces of five thousand demons, dreadfuly quick at fighting, dangeous to face and who will not beat a retreat.

40007290.author: पदार्थः
40007290.content: ते they, शूलैः  spears, पट्टिशैः  sharpedged spears, खङ्गै: swords, शिलावर्षैः by raining stones, द्रुमैरपि and with trees, शरवर्षैः by showers of arrows, अविच्छिन्नम् continuously, समन्ततः from all sides, तम् him(Rama), ववर्षुः rained.

40007290.author: Translation
40007290.content: The demons continuously hurled at him (Rama)  spears and swords and rained stones, trees and arrows from all sides

40007291.author: पदार्थः
40007291.content: धर्मात्मा righteous self, सः राघवः  Rama, प्राणहरम् destroyers of life, महत् mighty, द्रुमाणाम् trees, शिलानां च of stones and, वर्षम् rain, तीक्ष्णसायकैः with sharp arrows, प्रतिजग्राह retaliated.

40007291.author: Translation
40007291.content: Righteous Rama, retaliated with his sharp arrows such as the rain of trees and stones, the mighty destroyers of life.

40007292.author: पदार्थः
40007292.content: रामः Rama, निमीलितः closed his eyes, ऋषभः इव like a bull, तत् that, वर्षम् rain, प्रतिगृह्य  retaliated, सर्वरक्षसाम् all the demons, वधार्थम् to kill, परं excessively, क्रोधम् angry, भेजे felt.

40007292.author: Translation
40007292.content: Rama retaliated in great anger to kill without caring for the shower of weapons like a bull with its eyes closed.

40007293.author: पदार्थः
40007293.content: ततः then, क्रोधसमाविष्टः overpowered by anger, तेजसा glow, प्रदीप्त इव as though blazing, सहदूषणम् along with Dusana, सैन्यम् army, सर्वतः all over, शरैः with arrows, अवाकिरत् filled.

40007293.author: Translation
40007293.content: Overpowered by anger, Rama, with a blazing glow, covered Dusana and his army with his arrows.

40007294.author: पदार्थः
40007294.content: ततः thereafter, सेनापतिः chief of the army, दूषणः Dusana, क्रुद्धः angry, अशनिकल्पैः  comparable to thunderbolt, शरैः with arrows, तं राघवम् to that Rama, समवाकिरत् charged from everywhere.

40007294.author: Translation
40007294.content: Thereafter Dusana, chief of the army, angrily released at Rama equally powerful arrows comparable to thunderbolt.

40007295.author: पदार्थः
40007295.content: ततः thereafter, सुसङ्कृद्धः became furious, समरे in war, वीरः hero, रामः Rama, क्षुरेण with a swordlike, अस्य his, महत् great, धनुः bow, चतुर्भिः  four more, चतुरः four, हयान् horses, चिच्छेद cut to pieces.

40007295.author: Translation
40007295.content: Heroic Rama, mighty angry, then, broke the big bow of  Dusana, with his swordlike arrow. And with a series of four arrows cut his four horses to pieces.

40007296.author: पदार्थः
40007296.content: तीक्ष्णैः sharp ones, शरैः  arrows, अश्वान् horses, हत्वा killed, अर्धचन्द्रेण with an arrow of the shape of the cresunt moon, सारथेः charioteer's, शिरः head, जहार cut, त्रिभिः with three arrows, तत् that, रक्षः demon( Dushana), वक्षसि chest, विव्याध pierced.

40007296.author: Translation
40007296.content: After killing the horses with sharp arrows Rama severed the charioteer's head with an arrow of the shape of the crescent moon and pierced Dusana's chest with a set of three arrows.

40007297.author: पदार्थः
40007297.content: छिन्नधन्वा  with broken bow, विरथः no chariot, हताश्वः  horses killled, हतसारथिः  charioteer killed, सः he, गिरिशृङ्गाभम्  looking like a huge mountain top, रोमहर्षणम् causing horripilation, काञ्चनैः with golden, पट्टैः with bands, वेष्टितम् bound, देवसैन्यप्रमर्दनम् that which can crush even gods' army, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, आयसैः made of iron, शङ्कुभिः with nails, कीर्णम् covered, परवसोक्षितम्  sprinkled with enemy's marrow, वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शम् like the touch of thunderbolt, परगोपुरदारणम् that which can break open enemies fort, परिघम्  spear, जग्राह took up .

40007297.author: Translation
40007297.content: With his bow and chariot broken, charioteer and horses killed,  Dusana took up a spear in his hand that appeared like a huge mountain top. Bound by golden bands, covered the iron nails, wetted with the enemy's marrow it created a horripilation. It appeared as though it  could crush the army of gods and render the enemy powerless. It carried the killing touch of the thunderbolt and could break open the enemy's fort.

40007298.author: पदार्थः
40007298.content: छिन्नधन्वा  with broken bow, विरथः no chariot, हताश्वः  horses killled, हतसारथिः  charioteer killed, सः he, गिरिशृङ्गाभम्  looking like a huge mountain top, रोमहर्षणम् causing horripilation, काञ्चनैः with golden, पट्टैः with bands, वेष्टितम् bound, देवसैन्यप्रमर्दनम् that which can crush even gods' army, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, आयसैः made of iron, शङ्कुभिः with nails, कीर्णम् covered, परवसोक्षितम्  sprinkled with enemy's marrow, वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शम् like the touch of thunderbolt, परगोपुरदारणम् that which can break open enemies fort, परिघम्  spear, जग्राह took up .

40007298.author: Translation
40007298.content: With his bow and chariot broken, charioteer and horses killed,  Dusana took up a spear in his hand that appeared like a huge mountain top. Bound by golden bands, covered the iron nails, wetted with the enemy's marrow it created a horripilation. It appeared as though it  could crush the army of gods and render the enemy powerless. It carried the killing touch of the thunderbolt and could break open the enemy's fort.

40007299.author: पदार्थः
40007299.content: छिन्नधन्वा  with broken bow, विरथः no chariot, हताश्वः  horses killled, हतसारथिः  charioteer killed, सः he, गिरिशृङ्गाभम्  looking like a huge mountain top, रोमहर्षणम् causing horripilation, काञ्चनैः with golden, पट्टैः with bands, वेष्टितम् bound, देवसैन्यप्रमर्दनम् that which can crush even gods' army, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, आयसैः made of iron, शङ्कुभिः with nails, कीर्णम् covered, परवसोक्षितम्  sprinkled with enemy's marrow, वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शम् like the touch of thunderbolt, परगोपुरदारणम् that which can break open enemies fort, परिघम्  spear, जग्राह took up .

40007299.author: Translation
40007299.content: With his bow and chariot broken, charioteer and horses killed,  Dusana took up a spear in his hand that appeared like a huge mountain top. Bound by golden bands, covered the iron nails, wetted with the enemy's marrow it created a horripilation. It appeared as though it  could crush the army of gods and render the enemy powerless. It carried the killing touch of the thunderbolt and could break open the enemy's fort.

40007300.author: पदार्थः
40007300.content: क्रूरकर्मा cruel, निशाचरः demon, दूषणः Dusana, रणे in war, महोरगसङ्काशम् mighty serpent like, तं परिघम्  spear, प्रगृह्य holding, रामम् at Rama, अभ्यद्रवत् went forward.

40007300.author: Translation
40007300.content: With the spear that looked like a mighty serpent, Dusana, the cruel demon, advanced towards Rama.

40007301.author: पदार्थः
40007301.content: सः राघवः that Rama, अभिपतमानस्य  pouncing on him, तस्य दूषणस्य that Dusana, सहस्ताभरणौ adorned with armlets, भुजौ द्वाभ्याम् with two, शराभ्याम् with arrows, चिच्छेद cut.

40007301.author: Translation
40007301.content: Seeing Dusana going to pounce upon him, Rama cut off with two arrows both his arms adorned with armlets.

40007302.author: पदार्थः
40007302.content: रणमूर्धनि on the battle front, छिन्नहस्तस्य of one whose hands were cut off, तस्य his, महाकायः huge body, परिघः spear, भ्रष्टः fallen down, शक्रध्वजः इव like the banner of Indra, अग्रतः in front, पपात fell down.

40007302.author: Translation
40007302.content: With the hands amputated, his huge spear, like the banner of Indra, slipped off his hands and fell down on the ground on the battle front.

40007303.author: पदार्थः
40007303.content: सः दूषणः  Dusana, विकीर्णाभ्याम्  scattered, कराभ्याम् with both hands, विशीर्णाभ्याम् shattered to pieces, विषाणाभ्याम् with two tusks, मनस्वी proud one, महागजः इव like a mighty elephant, भुवि ground, पपात fell down.

40007303.author: Translation
40007303.content: Dusana fell down on the ground with broken hands like a proud elephant with both his tusks shattered.

40007304.author: पदार्थः
40007304.content: रणे in battle, निहतम् killed, भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen down, तं दूषणम् that Dusana, दृष्ट्वा seeing, सर्वभूतानि all beings, काकुत्स्थम् Rama, साधु साधु इति saying, 'well done well done', अपूजयन् hailed.

40007304.author: Translation
40007304.content: Seeing Dusaana collapse dead on the ground, all beings hailed Rama, saying, 'Well done, well done'.

40007305.author: पदार्थः
40007305.content: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे meanwhile, क्रुद्धाः angry  , महाकपालः Mahakapala, स्थूलाक्षः Stulaksha, महाबलः mighty, प्रमाथी च Pramathi, त्रयः all three, सेनाग्रयायिनः army chiefs, मृत्युपाशावपाशिताः  bound by the noose of death, संहृत्य all together, रामम् Rama, अभ्यद्रवन् ran towards.

40007305.author: Translation
40007305.content: Meanwhile all the three army chiefs, Mahakapala, Sthulaksha, and the mighty Pramathi ran towards Rama in anger, bound (as though) by the noose of death.

40007306.author: पदार्थः
40007306.content: महाकपालः Mahakapala, विपुलम् huge, शूलम् spear, उद्यम्य  lifted up, स्थूलाक्षः Sthulaksha, राक्षसः demon, पट्टिसम् sharpedged spear, गृह्य holding, प्रमाथी च and Pramathi too, परश्वधं च with a battleaxe.

40007306.author: Translation
40007306.content: Mahakapala had a huge spear, Sthulaksha, a sharpedged spear and Pramathi, a battleaxe.

40007307.author: पदार्थः
40007307.content: राघवः Rama, तूर्णम् quickly, आपततः  attacking, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, शितैः with sharp weapons, तीक्ष्णाग्रैः  pointed , सायकैः with arrows, सम्प्राप्तान् those who arrived, अतिथीनिव like guests, प्रतिजग्राह received.

40007307.author: Translation
40007307.content: On seeing them rushing to attack him with sharp weapons, Rama received them quickly with pointed arrows as though they were guests.

40007308.author: पदार्थः
40007308.content: परमेषुभिः sharp arrows, महाकपालस्य Mahakapala's, शिरः head, चिच्छेद cut to pieces, असङ्ख्येयैः with innumerable, बाणौघैः  arrows, प्रमाथिनम् Pramathi also, प्रममाथ killed, सः he, हतः dead, विटपी with branches, महाद्रुमः इव like a huge tree, भूमौ on the ground, पपात fell down.

40007308.author: Translation
40007308.content: Mahakapala's head was cut to pieces with sharp arrows and Pramathi was killed with a countless series  of arrows. Pramathi's body, like a huge tree with many branches collapsed on the ground.

40007309.author: पदार्थः
40007309.content: परमेषुभिः sharp arrows, महाकपालस्य Mahakapala's, शिरः head, चिच्छेद cut to pieces, असङ्ख्येयैः with innumerable, बाणौघैः  arrows, प्रमाथिनम् Pramathi also, प्रममाथ killed, सः he, हतः dead, विटपी with branches, महाद्रुमः इव like a huge tree, भूमौ on the ground, पपात fell down.

40007309.author: Translation
40007309.content: Mahakapala's head was cut to pieces with sharp arrows and Pramathi was killed with a countless series  of arrows. Pramathi's body, like a huge tree with many branches collapsed on the ground.

40007310.author: पदार्थः
40007310.content: स्थूलाक्षस्य Sthulaksha's, अक्षिणी eyes, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp, सायकैः with arrows, पूरयामास filled, कुपितः an angry, पञ्चसाहस्रैः with five thousand, बाणौघैः with arrows, दूषणस्य Dusana's, पञ्चसाहस्रान् five thousand, अनुगान् followers, क्षणात् in a moment, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama, अनयत् sent.

40007310.author: Translation
40007310.content: Rama filled the eyes of Sthulaksha with sharp arrows, and in anger shot five thousand arrows at the five thousand followers of Dusana in a moment and sent them to the abode of Yama.

40007311.author: पदार्थः
40007311.content: दूषणं Dusana, निहतम् killed, तस्य his, पदानुगान् followers, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, खरः Khara, क्रुद्धः angry , महाबलान् extremely strong, सेनाध्यक्षान् chiefs of the army, व्यादिदेश commanded.

40007311.author: Translation
40007311.content: Seeing Dusana and his followers killed, enraged Khara commanded his extremely strong army chiefs this way:

40007312.author: पदार्थः
40007312.content: अयं this one, सपदानुगः along with his followers, दूषणः Dooshana, सङ्ख्ये in battle, (वि)निहतः killed, सर्व राक्षसाः all the demons, महत्या with great, सेनयासार्धम् along with army, युद्ध्वा after fighting, नानाविधाकारैः different kinds, शस्त्रैः weapons, कुमानुषम् wicked human being, रामम् Rama, हनध्वम्  should kill.

40007312.author: Translation
40007312.content: Dusana and his followers are killed in the battle. You, all the demons, along with your great army and different kinds of weapons should kill that wicked human being, Rama.

40007313.author: पदार्थः
40007313.content: अयं this one, सपदानुगः along with his followers, दूषणः Dooshana, सङ्ख्ये in battle, (वि)निहतः killed, सर्व राक्षसाः all the demons, महत्या with great, सेनयासार्धम् along with army, युद्ध्वा after fighting, नानाविधाकारैः different kinds, शस्त्रैः weapons, कुमानुषम् wicked human being, रामम् Rama, हनध्वम्  should kill.

40007313.author: Translation
40007313.content: Dusana and his followers are killed in the battle. You, all the demons, along with your great army and different kinds of weapons should kill that wicked human being, Rama.

40007314.author: पदार्थः
40007314.content: खरः Khara, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, क्रुद्धः angry  one, राममेव towards Rama, अभिदुद्रुवे ran, श्येनगामी Syenagami, पृथुग्रीवः Pruthugriva, यज्ञशत्रुः Yajnasatru, विहङ्गमः Vihangama, दुर्जयः Durjaya, करवीराक्षः Karaveeraksha, परुषः Parusha, कालकार्मुकः Kalakarmuka, मेघमाली Meghamali, महामाली Mahamali, सर्पास्य: Sarpasya, रुधिराशनः Rudhirasana, एते these, महावीर्याः mighty heroes, द्वादश twelve, बलाध्यक्षाः army chiefs, ससैनिकाः with army, शरोत्तमान् sharpest of arrows, विसृजन्तः releasing, राममेव towards Rama  alone, अभ्यधावन्त ran forward.

40007314.author: Translation
40007314.content: Having spoken thus, angry Khara ran towards Rama. Syenagami, Pruthugriva, Yajnasatru, Vihanga, Durjaya, Karaveeraksha, Parusha, Kalakarmuka, Meghamali, Mahamali, Sarpasya, Rudhirasanaall these twelve valiant army chiefs along with their forces rushed towards Rama, releasing the sharpest arrows at him.

40007315.author: पदार्थः
40007315.content: खरः Khara, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, क्रुद्धः angry  one, राममेव towards Rama, अभिदुद्रुवे ran, श्येनगामी Syenagami, पृथुग्रीवः Pruthugriva, यज्ञशत्रुः Yajnasatru, विहङ्गमः Vihangama, दुर्जयः Durjaya, करवीराक्षः Karaveeraksha, परुषः Parusha, कालकार्मुकः Kalakarmuka, मेघमाली Meghamali, महामाली Mahamali, सर्पास्य: Sarpasya, रुधिराशनः Rudhirasana, एते these, महावीर्याः mighty heroes, द्वादश twelve, बलाध्यक्षाः army chiefs, ससैनिकाः with army, शरोत्तमान् sharpest of arrows, विसृजन्तः releasing, राममेव towards Rama  alone, अभ्यधावन्त ran forward.

40007315.author: Translation
40007315.content: Having spoken thus, angry Khara ran towards Rama. Syenagami, Pruthugriva, Yajnasatru, Vihanga, Durjaya, Karaveeraksha, Parusha, Kalakarmuka, Meghamali, Mahamali, Sarpasya, Rudhirasanaall these twelve valiant army chiefs along with their forces rushed towards Rama, releasing the sharpest arrows at him.

40007316.author: पदार्थः
40007316.content: खरः Khara, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, क्रुद्धः angry  one, राममेव towards Rama, अभिदुद्रुवे ran, श्येनगामी Syenagami, पृथुग्रीवः Pruthugriva, यज्ञशत्रुः Yajnasatru, विहङ्गमः Vihangama, दुर्जयः Durjaya, करवीराक्षः Karaveeraksha, परुषः Parusha, कालकार्मुकः Kalakarmuka, मेघमाली Meghamali, महामाली Mahamali, सर्पास्य: Sarpasya, रुधिराशनः Rudhirasana, एते these, महावीर्याः mighty heroes, द्वादश twelve, बलाध्यक्षाः army chiefs, ससैनिकाः with army, शरोत्तमान् sharpest of arrows, विसृजन्तः releasing, राममेव towards Rama  alone, अभ्यधावन्त ran forward.

40007316.author: Translation
40007316.content: Having spoken thus, angry Khara ran towards Rama. Syenagami, Pruthugriva, Yajnasatru, Vihanga, Durjaya, Karaveeraksha, Parusha, Kalakarmuka, Meghamali, Mahamali, Sarpasya, Rudhirasanaall these twelve valiant army chiefs along with their forces rushed towards Rama, releasing the sharpest arrows at him.

40007317.author: पदार्थः
40007317.content: तेजस्वी powerful Rama, ततः then, पावकसङ्काशैः  glowing like fire, हेमवज्रविभूषितैः studded with gold and diamonds, सायकैः arrows, तस्य his, सैन्यस्य army's, शेषम् remaining, जघान slayed.

40007317.author: Translation
40007317.content: Powerful Rama thereafter slayed the remaining army with his weapons studded with gold and diamonds and glowing like fire.

40007318.author: पदार्थः
40007318.content: रुक्मपुङ्खाः goldtipped arrows, सधूमाः covered with smoke, पावकाः इव like fire, ते विशिखाः tips of arrows, वज्राः thunderbolts, महाद्रुमानिव like huge trees, तानि those, रक्षांसि demons, निजघ्नुः shattered.

40007318.author: Translation
40007318.content: The goldtipped arrows which resembled fire covered with smoke shattered the army of demons like huge trees knocked down by thunder.

40007319.author: पदार्थः
40007319.content: रामः Rama, रक्षसाम् of demons, शतम् one hundred, एकेन कर्णिना by a single stroke, शतेन one hundred, सहस्रम् thousand, सहस्रेण thousand, रणमूर्धनि on the battle front, जघान killed.

40007319.author: Translation
40007319.content: Rama killed a hundred demons  with one hundred arrows by a single stroke. The same way he killed a thousand of them with a thousand arrows on the battle front.

40007320.author: पदार्थः
40007320.content: तैः by them, भिन्नवर्माभरणाः  with broken shields and ornaments, छिन्नभिन्नशरासनाः the bows broken to pieces, रजनीचराः demons, शोणिता दिग्धाः smeared with blood, धरण्याम् on the ground, निपेतुः fell.

40007320.author: Translation
40007320.content: The demons fell down on the ground with their shields  and ornaments broken, their  bows stained with blood splintered.

40007321.author: पदार्थः
40007321.content: समरे in the battle, पतितैः by those fallen down, मुक्तकेशैः loose hair, शोणितोक्षितैः by those wet with blood, तैः those, कृत्स्ना entire, वसुधा ground, महावेदिः a great sacrificial altar, कुशैरिव like the Kusa grass, आस्तीर्णा was spread all over.

40007321.author: Translation
40007321.content: The entire ground was littered with bodies of demons fallen in the battle with loose hair and with drops of blood on them looking like a great sacrificial altar strewn all over with kusa grass.

40007322.author: पदार्थः
40007322.content: निहतराक्षसम् with demons killed, वनम् the forest, क्षणेन तु in a moment, महाघोरम् very dreadful, मांसशोणितकर्दमम् soil soaked with the mud of flesh and blood, निरयप्रख्य like a hell, बभूव appeared.

40007322.author: Translation
40007322.content: With the slaughtered bodies of demons lying on the ground, the forest in a moment looked very dreadful like hell with the mud of soil soaked with flesh and blood.

40007323.author: पदार्थः
40007323.content: मानुषेण by a human being, पदातिना going on foot, रामेण Rama, एकेन alone, भीमकर्मणाम्  of formidable  acts, रक्षसाम् demons, चतुर्दश fourteen, सहस्राणि thousands, हतानि were killed.

40007323.author: Translation
40007323.content: Fourteen thousand formidable demons were killed by Rama, a pedestrian human,  singlehanded.

40007324.author: पदार्थः
40007324.content: महारथः great warrior, खरः Khara, राक्षसः demon, त्रिशिराः Trisira, तस्य सैन्सस्य सर्वस्य of that entire army, शेषः were remanant, रिपुसूदनः destroyer of foes, रामश्च Rama also.

40007324.author: Translation
40007324.content: Of that entire army great warrior Khara,Trisira and Rama, destroyer of foes alone remained.

40007325.author: पदार्थः
40007325.content: महासत्त्वाः mighty, घोराः dreadful, दुर्विषहाः intolerable, सर्वे all, शेषाः the remaining, ते they, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, अग्रजेन by the elder brother, रणमूर्धनि on the battle front, हताः were killed.

40007325.author: Translation
40007325.content: The rest of the mighty, dreadful, intolerable demons were killed on the war front by Rama, elder brother to Lakshmana.

40007326.author: पदार्थः
40007326.content: ततः thereafter, खरः Khara, महाहवे in the great fight, बलीयसा by the mighty, रामेण by Rama, हतम् killed, तत् that, भीमबलम् formidable army, समीक्ष्य  seeing, तदा then, उद्यताशनिः  raised thunderbolt, इन्द्र इव like Indra, महता with a great, रथेन chariot, रामम् Rama, समाससाद went forward.

40007326.author: Translation
40007326.content: Thereafter seeing the formidable army killed by mighty Rama, Khara lifted a thunderbolt like Indra, and advanced towards Rama in a great chariot. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वालमिकिय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षङ्विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentysixth sarga in Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
